summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatter entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title; rich/console.py adds set_window_title (returns True when written, False when not a terminal); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). CHANGELOG.md gained an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Per instructions, no tests were run, no repository code was executed, and nothing was committed, so the tests and mypy are unverified.
